propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) despite jira.text.field.character.limit being admin-configurable with range 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when a DC administrator raises or removes the comment limit, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
sanitize_comment and fit_comment are decoupled from the description fitter so changes to description truncation logic cannot inadvertently retarget comment handling
comment_max_chars is now configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, matching jira.text.field.character.limit's stock default per JRASERVER-28519
/rest/api/2/application-properties is admin-only and unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, so auto-discovery of the live limit is not viable and configuration is the sole remedy
